title: Laminate Repairing Kit Wax System Floor Worktop Sturdy Casing Chips Scratches Mending Only Consumables
description:
Laminate Repairing Kit Wax System Floor Worktop Sturdy Casing Chips Scratches Mending Only Consumables
Made of fine quality material, practical, easy to operate and use, wide application range, has a long service life.

Features:
Recommended for repairing scratches to laminate floors, worktops, furniture, cabinets, timbers, window frames, etc.
Perfect for DIY devotee and other users.
The kit includes a versatile range of materials that can be used to repairing laminate flooring and surfaces in the most popular colors.
It can also be used to repairing kitchens and other decorative laminate worktops, and even wooden furnishings.
Light scratch or damage can be effortlessly repaired.
Easy to use filler sticks.
Simply recreate the color of your damaged boards by mixing the 11 wax blocks.
Perfect to use on glass, laminate floors and to decorate mirrors and tiles.
Best for use in the home, caravan, work place, school, hotel, care home, office, boat, etc.

Specifications:
Main material: ABS+resin
Battery: 2 * AA battery (not included)
Electric length: 150mm / 5.9in
Wax block size: 40 * 15 * 10mm / 1.6 * 0.6 * 0.4in
Package size: 195 * 180 * 40mm / 7.7 * 7.1 * 1.6in
Package weight: 333g / 11.7ounce
Packing List:
1 * Electric Iron
11 * Wax Block
2 * Scraping Block
1 * Sponge
1 * Cloth
1 * Storage Box
